AdminPasskeyConfig.title: AdminPasskeyConfig
AdminPasskeyConfig.description: Double-hashed SHA-256 verifier and timestamp for password-only KNAS admin access.

verifierHash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the admin password proof.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of when the admin password was created or updated.

AdminStatusConfig.title: AdminStatusConfig
AdminStatusConfig.description: Public boolean flag indicating whether the KNAS admin password has been initialized.

configured.description: True once knas_access has been configured.

AdminAuthCheck.title: AdminAuthCheck
AdminAuthCheck.description: Write-only verification gate document validating password proof in Firestore rules.

proof.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 proof derived from the admin password.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp matching request.time for atomic batch verification.

CatalogProductOverride.title: CatalogProductOverride
CatalogProductOverride.description: Admin-editable fields or newly created store products in catalog_products.

image.description: Product image URL or compressed gallery data URI.

isCustom.description: True when created directly from KNAS AdminPanel.

published.description: Whether this override is synchronized with the storefront.

deleted.description: True when the admin has deleted this product from the catalog.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last edit.

CatalogBundleOverride.title: CatalogBundleOverride
CatalogBundleOverride.description: Admin-editable fields (image, title, description, price) for a store bundle/combo.

published.description: Whether this combo override is publicly visible on the storefront.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last edit.

/admin_settings/knas_access.description: Write-only after initial setup; stores the SHA-256 verifier hash of the KNAS admin password.

/admin_settings/status.description: Publicly gettable setup flag indicating whether KNAS password has been configured.

/admin_auth_checks/{checkId}.description: Write-only password proof gate verified via hashing.sha256 in Firestore rules.
